answer: The summit is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the sable. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ivory of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
